quality_check.description: A single tall screen-print-style atlas card with a distressed soot-black outer edge, bone-white margin, and inset illustration window. Numerous pale swans move through a storm-blue-gray landscape and water pattern, while a dramatically oversized soot-black swan enters from the upper right and disrupts the composition. Curved technical construction lines and angular vermilion marks cluster and diverge around the black swan. The image uses flat graphic shapes, muted blue-gray and teal tones, dry archival grain, worn print texture, and no visible text, labels, captions, numbers, UI, storyboard panels, or grid structure.
violations: The file dimensions are 1143×2048, which is slightly narrower than an exact 9:16 aspect ratio.
Several of the smaller white swans are rendered as outlined or modeled figures rather than consistently as simple white silhouettes.
The smaller swans follow a more winding landscape-and-water flow than a clearly unified calm diagonal pattern.
The geometric model traces are relatively elaborate and sweeping, with some lines reading as general construction arcs rather than only restrained expected-model geometry.
The vermilion rupture marks extend across a fairly broad central-right area rather than remaining extremely sparse.
The interior introduces a recognizable watery landscape with reeds, rocks, and channels, making the composition somewhat more environmental than the requested pale-ground symbolic abstraction.

prompt:
Here’s the standalone Gemini image prompt:

Edit

Create exactly one vertical 9:16 image in a unified screen-print illustration style, never a storyboard, grid, collage, multi-panel layout, captioned graphic, or text-bearing image. Inside the recurring vertically oriented atlas-card frame, use a thick imperfect soot-black outer print edge, narrow bone-white breathing margin, and slightly inset rectangular illustration window with tiny registration offsets and worn ink corners. Fill the full illustration height naturally with no reserved lower caption strip, blank band, empty panel, or artificial low-detail zone. On a bone-white to pale-stone ground, show a wide symbolic composition: many small white swan silhouettes move in a calm, orderly diagonal pattern, subtly reinforced by restrained storm-blue-gray geometric traces suggesting an expected model; from the opposite upper-right direction, one dramatically oversized soot-black swan cuts across and ruptures the pattern, with thin technical lines visibly diverging or fracturing around its arrival. Use bold flat silhouettes, crisp screen-printed contours, restrained cel-like shape separation, dry matte ink, coarse archival print grain, slight registration wear, broad graphic light fields, deep ink shadows, muted storm blue-gray and restrained oxidized teal, with only a sparse vermilion accent at the rupture. No photorealism, glossy CGI, anime, watercolor softness, sepia engraving, neon palette, readable charts, labels, UI, letters, numbers, captions, or words. Use style_reference only to anchor the canonical medium, texture, palette, contour quality, lighting, and print finish; use world_keyframe only to maintain the established atlas-card frame language and world-level visual consistency. Do not copy either reference’s pose, object placement, layout, or composition. Do not import any unrelated opening environment. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: every image appears inside the same vertically oriented screen-printed atlas card: a thick imperfect soot-black outer print edge, narrow bone-white breathing margin, and a slightly inset rectangular illustration window with tiny registration offsets and worn ink corners. Diagrams, environments, swans, tools, markets, and technology scenes all remain inside this repeated print-window grammar, with the border thickness and inner margins held consistent throughout the episode. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
